Asad Daud: 
Thank you so much. Good morning, everyone. I welcome you all to Aeroflex Industries Limited 
Q2 FY27 Earnings Call. Joining us today are members of our senior management team, along 
with representatives from Strategic Growth Advisors, our Investor Relations Partner. 
 
I hope you had the opportunity to review our financial results and investor presentation, which 
are available both on the stock exchange and also on our company's website. We are pleased to 
report that our best ever results with quarterly revenue crossing INR200 crores milestone for the 
first time ever. 
 
This achievement reflects sustained growth momentum across all our verticals and supported by 
strong demand for our core products and increasing traction that we are witnessing in the liquid 
cooling vertical. It also highlights the strength of our diversified business model, a growing 
contribution from value-added products and our strategic positioning in high-growth segments, 
especially the high-performance data center infrastructure. 
 
During H1 FY27, our metal flexible hose business delivered strong growth with revenues 
increasing by 40% on a year-on-year basis, supported by demand across various end-user 
industries and across our established international customer base. The assemblies and other 
value-added products business also registered a growth of 44% on a year-on-year basis, which 
reflects increased demand for high-precision engineered flow solutions. 
 
The liquid cooling vertical continues to gain significant traction driven by the growing adoption 
of advanced cooling technologies in high-performance data centers. This vertical contributed 
24% to our revenue in H1 FY27, which makes a significant milestone in our evolution from 
being just a flexible hose provider to an integrated provider of advanced flow control and liquid 
cooling solutions. 
 
We have also announced the merger of Hyd-Air Engineering, which is our wholly-owned 
subsidiary with Aeroflex. This is aimed at strategically integrating operations of Hyd-Air into 
Aeroflex and to create a more streamlined and efficient business structure. The merger is also 
expected to leverage existing infrastructure.

It will help to optimize the resource allocation and also strengthen the company's ability to scale 
in-house capabilities in line with our business requirements. By eliminating operational overlaps 
and simplifying the corporate structure and also optimizing the cost, this consolidation is 
expected to reduce the administrative and compliance related costs, enhance our operational 
coordination, improve resource utilization and facilitate more and efficient capital allocation. 
 
Now talking about the data center opportunity. The rapid advancement of AI and high-
performance computing is transforming the entire global data center infrastructure, including in 
India as well. Higher computing requirements are driving increased rack densities and heat 
generation, which is accelerating the shift from conventional air cooling to advanced liquid 
cooling technologies. 
 
Hyperscalers, cloud service providers and global technology companies are making huge 
investments in data centers, not only internationally, but also in India as well. And this is creating 
a growing demand for reliable, leakproof and precision engineered flow control solutions. 
 
Aeroflex is well positioned to participate in this opportunity through its expertise in the flexible 
flow solutions in terms of engineered assemblies and also liquid cooling skid assemblies. Our 
SFN skid assemblies facilitate controlled coolant circulation and also support efficient data 
center cooling operations. 
 
We are also strengthening our capabilities in advanced flow control components and flexible 
connection solutions to address the ever-evolving requirements of the liquid cooling 
infrastructure. 
 
We aim to progressively strengthen our presence across the data center value chain, leveraging 
our manufacturing capabilities, our customized engineering solutions and our diversified 
product portfolio. 
 
Now talking about our capacity expansion. In this month, we have announced a capacity 
expansion, which involves total capital expenditure of INR202 crores. This is aimed at from a 
long-term growth outlook and also increase the demand visibility that we are seeing across both 
our sectors. 
 
In terms of the stainless steel flexible flow solutions, we have already completed the expansion 
of our manufacturing capacity to 20 million meters per annum. And we have planned a further 
expansion of 10 million meters per annum, which will take our total capacity to 30 million meters 
per annum, and it is estimated to be completed by March 2028. 
 
And it involves an investment of approximately INR124 crores. This expansion program will 
comprise a mix of both brownfield expansion at our -- at the existing Taloja facility and also a 
proposed new manufacturing facility for hose assemblies. 
 
Now talking about the expansion plan for the skid assemblies, our current capacity expansion 
plan of expansion to 15,000 units per annum is expected to be completed by December 2026. 
Out of that, we have already commissioned the 12,000 units per annum.

And to add on top of that, we have planned the next phase of expansion, thereby raising our 
capacity from 15,000 units per annum to 30,000 skid assemblies per annum, and the same is 
expected to be completed by March 2028. And this will entail an additional investment of INR78 
crores. 
 
The overall investment of INR202 crores will be funded primarily through a combination of 
internal accruals, bridge loan financing and equity fund raise if required. At the peak capacity 
utilization, these additional capacities are expected to generate incremental revenue potential of 
approximately INR500 crores to INR550 crores per year. 
 
The expansion will be implemented in a phased manner, strengthening our ability to execute 
larger customer programs and capitalize on opportunities across data centers and other high-
growth industries. 
 
To talk about our technology innovation and R&D, which remains central to our long-term 
growth strategy, and we continue to invest in new production capabilities, new product 
development, manufacturing process improvements and enhancing our engineering capabilities. 
 
I'm also glad to share that we have been granted a patent for our invention of developing a system 
and method for automatically generating a 3D computer-aided model for braided hose 
assemblies. This technology automates the generation of 3D CAD models of braided hose 
assemblies, enabling greater efficiency, consistency and precision in product development. 
 
Going forward, we will continue to focus on product innovation, process automation and 
advanced manufacturing technologies to develop customized solutions for specialized and 
mission-critical applications. 
 
Looking ahead, we remain confident about our long-term growth prospects. Our strategy is 
focused on 3 key priorities. First is to strengthen our core metallic flexible hoses and assemblies 
business through capacity expansion, automation, product innovation and deeper market 
penetration. 
 
Second is to scale up our liquid cooling solutions business by expanding our manufacturing 
capabilities, capacity, strengthening our engineering capabilities and also increasing the 
engagement with our customers across the data center ecosystem. And thirdly, to continuously 
invest in technology, R&D and advanced manufacturing to develop specialized solutions for 
these high-growth industries. 
 
The global transition towards AI-led computing and liquid-cooled data center infrastructure 
represents a multiyear opportunity for us. And our recently announced expansion program 
reflects our confidence in this opportunity and also our commitment to building these 
capabilities required to support the future growth. 
 
Alongside our growth investments, we also remain focused on maintaining a strong balance 
sheet, healthy cash flows and financial discipline. This will provide us the financial flexibility 
to fund our future growth initiatives while also maintaining a strong financial position.
